items.title: 统一并稳固 bootstrap 与构建依赖关系
items.context: 入口层当前最容易因为 dist 缺失、跨包依赖或运行时模块实例不一致而失效。

happy.desc: 完整入口构建后运行 koala.js/koala-codex.js → main+utils 都能加载且 aux_* 可用

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/entrypoints.json:4 — execute builds both packages, then runs bin/koala.js aux_doc_list and bin/koala-codex.js session_brief, so the full wrapper path loads main+utils and exposes both aux_* and Codex entrypoints | severity:info

packages/main/tests/fixtures/entrypoints.json:4 — execute rebuilds both packages and runs bin/koala.js aux_doc_list plus bin/koala-codex.js session_brief, so the full wrapper path proves main+utils load together and aux_* stays available | severity:info

packages/main/tests/fixtures/entrypoints.json:4 — execute rebuilds main+utils and runs bin/koala.js aux_doc_list plus bin/koala-codex.js session_brief, so the full wrapper path still proves main+utils load together and aux_* remains available | severity:info

edge.desc: 遇到跨包共享依赖或 dist 缺失风险时 → 入口层会通过稳定约束或清晰错误暴露问题

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/entrypoints.json:19 — execute removes packages/utils/dist and asserts Recovery, Missing build artifacts, and the exact utils build command, so dist-risk is surfaced with actionable guidance instead of silent failure | severity:info

packages/main/tests/fixtures/entrypoints.json:19 — execute removes packages/utils/dist and asserts Recovery, Missing build artifacts, and the utils rebuild command, so dist loss is still surfaced as an actionable bootstrap failure | severity:info

adversarial.desc: 换一个没有偶然模块解析优势的环境时 → 完整入口不会再次因依赖实例分裂而静默失效

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/entrypoints.json:36 — case only simulates missing packages/main/dist and raw-module-error suppression; it does not create an alternate resolution path or second dependency instance, so dependency-instance split risk remains untested | severity:high

packages/main/tests/fixtures/entrypoints.json:36 — execute plants a root-level zod package that throws if imported, then still gets aux_doc_list successfully and asserts noRootZodCrash, so an alternate resolution path no longer causes silent dependency-instance split failure | severity:info

packages/main/tests/fixtures/entrypoints.json:36 — execute plants a root-level zod package that throws if imported, then still gets aux_doc_list successfully and asserts noRootZodCrash, so an alternate resolution path no longer causes silent dependency-instance split failure | severity:info

items.title: 为 init、bootstrap、wrapper 添加可重复的回归验证
items.context: 把这类问题从人工发现改成自动暴露，尤其覆盖 koala.js、koala-codex.js 和 init 产物。

happy.desc: 执行针对 init、bootstrap、wrapper 的回归验证 → 能稳定覆盖本仓库入口和新项目初始化产物

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/entrypoints.json:53 — execute runs npm run test:entrypoints, and that regression script covers repo wrappers plus temp init output, so init/bootstrap/wrapper verification is automated rather than manual-only | severity:info

packages/main/tests/fixtures/entrypoints.json:53 — execute runs npm run test:entrypoints, so wrapper/init/bootstrap regression coverage is exercised automatically instead of relying on manual repo checks | severity:info

packages/main/tests/fixtures/entrypoints.json:53 — execute runs npm run test:entrypoints, so wrapper/init/bootstrap regression coverage is exercised automatically instead of relying on manual repo checks | severity:info

edge.desc: init 产物与当前仓库入口存在差异时 → 回归验证仍能显式暴露不一致

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/entrypoints.json:69 — execute initializes a temp project and asserts generated .Codex artifacts plus fallback text, so drift between init output and expected Codex entrypoint guidance is surfaced by the fixture | severity:info

packages/main/tests/fixtures/entrypoints.json:69 — execute initializes a temp project and asserts generated .Codex artifacts plus fallback guidance, so drift between repo entrypoints and init output is exposed by automation | severity:info

packages/main/tests/fixtures/entrypoints.json:69 — execute initializes a temp project and asserts generated .Codex artifacts plus fallback guidance, so drift between repo entrypoints and init output is exposed by automation | severity:info

adversarial.desc: 后续有人只手工验证当前仓库时 → 自动回归仍能拦住 wrapper/init 场景的漏测

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/entrypoints.json:86 — case only checks repeated init is idempotent; it does not verify that automated regression catches wrapper/init omissions when someone only hand-tests the current repo | severity:high

packages/main/tests/fixtures/entrypoints.json:86 — case only proves repeated init stays idempotent; it still does not assert that the automated regression suite would catch wrapper/init omissions when someone only hand-tests the current repo, so the adversarial anti-regression intent remains uncovered | severity:high

packages/main/tests/fixtures/entrypoints.json:86 — execute temporarily removes bin/koala-codex.js and expects npm run test:entrypoints to fail while mentioning the missing wrapper, so the automated regression suite now catches wrapper/init omissions that hand-testing the current repo could miss | severity:info

items.title: 明确完整入口与降级入口的文档和报错体验
items.context: 用户在 dist 缺失或 utils 不可用时，需要得到明确引导，而不是模糊失败。

happy.desc: 完整入口失败或降级到全局 koala 时 → 用户能得到明确恢复路径和正确命令提示

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/entrypoints.json:102 — execute forces bootstrap failure and asserts Recovery plus KOALA_ACTIVITY_SOURCE fallback guidance, so users get a concrete recovery path when the full entrypoint cannot start | severity:info

packages/main/tests/fixtures/entrypoints.json:102 — execute forces bootstrap failure and asserts both Recovery guidance and the KOALA_ACTIVITY_SOURCE fallback command, so users get a concrete recovery path on full-entrypoint failure | severity:info

packages/main/tests/fixtures/entrypoints.json:102 — execute forces bootstrap failure and asserts both Recovery guidance and the KOALA_ACTIVITY_SOURCE fallback command, so users get a concrete recovery path on full-entrypoint failure | severity:info

edge.desc: 没有本地 codex wrapper 的项目里 → README 与错误提示仍能指导用户走降级入口
